Jamie: quick q — how should the console handle saved-query snapshots vs live query views when we start rolling out telemetry strata + per-route quotas? thinking saved snapshots that include sampled telemetry + metadata, plus a 'live' toggle.
Rohan: +1 to snapshots but we must limit stored sample size. store a summary + pointer to archived raw sample. avoid returning huge payloads to the UI.
Priya: we can reuse the telemetry-strata service — it already emits sampled events with a sampling_key. snapshot should record the sampling_rate and sampling_key so results are reproducible.
Alex: UX: show `Snapshot (t=2026-01-12 10:22 UTC) • 500 samples • 1%` and a Live toggle. clicking Live should fetch current results with a small banner: "live results may differ due to sampling".
Sofia: design idea: tiny pill next to saved query: `Snapshot • 500 • 1%` + subtle chevron to expand details. when >1k samples show a truncated preview.
Morgan: sys note — fetching live samples is potentially heavy. we should gate with quota checks and surface estimated token/cost before running. add tracing id to each fetch.
Alex: minimal API proposal:
```
GET /api/v1/console/saved_queries/{id}?view=snapshot
Response: { "id":"...", "snapshot_time":"2026-01-12T10:22:00Z", "sample_count": 500, "sampling_rate": "1%", "summary": { ... } }
```
Jamie: nice. can snapshot objects also be marked `canary_pinned:true` so routing policies can route a small % of real traffic to a model variant for debugging? @Rohan thoughts.
Rohan: doable. routing layer supports per-route metadata overrides today. we'll need an auth check + audit log and a small TTL so canary pins don't persist forever. plumb through the rollout service.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary rollout created: #canary-781 by @Jamie
Priya: caveat — if teams use snapshots as ground-truth for evals, we must persist exact sampled ids (or hashes) to reproduce. suggest optional `persist_samples` flag on snapshot creation.
Morgan: retention: default 30 days, configurable per-org. large enterprise customers can request longer retention via support and separate storage tier.
Alex: action items: 1) define API schema + snapshot summary fields; 2) UI mock for snapshot pill + live toggle + cost warning; 3) routing flag integration with TTL + audit; 4) retention policy + docs; 5) opt-in `persist_samples` flow.
Jamie: thanks all — I'll draft a short RFC and attach mocks. looping in @eng-ml for model-variant UX next week. :thumbsup:
